enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +3: Passive: +3 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+1 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +1 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.
Kinetic Lore +7: Passive: Your Force, Physical and Untyped spells gain a 7% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Impulse +47: Passive: +47 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
